messages:
gabe: hey everyone — small personal update: i got married last weekend! kept it tiny at the courthouse and then had a curry night with a couple friends and family. :tada: pics in the album (private link) — https://photos.example/abc123. thinking of bringing some leftovers to the office on Friday to celebrate. no pressure, just a little get-together. who’s in?
mira: OMG CONGRATS!!!! :confetti_ball: so so happy for you!!
talia: wait WHAT? WHEN DID THIS HAPPEN?? curry night?? you didn’t tell us!! :joy:
omar: congrats gabe!! photos please. also important poll: Korma vs Biryani for the office leftovers? react with :+1: for Korma, :heart: for Biryani
zara: adding a calendar placeholder — which Friday works? i’m free after 3pm.
people-ops-bot: congrats Gabe! If you’d like a small office celebration or a physical card, mention @people-ops and we’ll coordinate. :tada:
mira: i’ll bring cake (and a mango lassi) 
gabe: thanks y’all!! photos are in the private album above. friday 4pm works best for me. @people-ops — a card would be lovely but please don’t go out of pocket on my behalf.
omar: i’ll handle savory sides. also can we have a chutney bar? :drooling_face:
talia: RSVP: yes. will happily sample leftovers. also low-key jealous.
zara: RSVP yes, bringing sparkling water.
mira: RSVP yes — cake + lassi confirmed.
people-ops-bot: noted — creating a calendar invite for Friday 4-5pm in the #all-hands room. Everyone who’s RSVPed will be added. :calendar:
gabe: and a little fun fact — lina basically volunteered to take pics and unofficially ‘officiated’ (she made it feel official). will tag her in the album.
lina: omg i demand a slice of cake :grin: congrats to my favorite engineer!!
omar: formal request submitted: spice tolerance badges for anyone brave enough to try Gabe’s leftovers. :medal:
